diagnosis: V1.72 correctly removed GitHub-side generic urllib3 retries, but the Worker still made two immediate 6-second upstream attempts inside each relay request. The real V1.72 run showed 27 transient relay 504s, so immediate back-to-back retrying did not provide sufficient recovery separation and occupied relay detail worker slots during both attempts.

change.python_recovery_pass: one delayed pass after the primary detail batch, only for relay transport failures, HTTP 429, or HTTP 5xx
